Join forces with [[Lieutenant Murunda]]'s guards and eliminate the [[Margonite]]s infesting [[Sebelkeh Basilica]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Meet Lieutenant Murunda and her soldiers in [[the Mirror of Lyss]].
* Kill the demons infesting the Sebelkeh Basilica. 7...0 of 7 groups remain.
* See Lieutenant Murunda for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* 10 [[Lightbringer]] Points

==Walkthrough==
Start from [[Dzagonur Bastion]], and meet Lieutenant Murunda just outside in the Mirror of Lyss. After speaking to Murunda, a Vabbi Guard Captain and 4 Vabbi Guards will join your party as allies.

From here, it's a simple search and destroy type quest, as you follow the quest pointer to each group of Margonites and defeat them.  Be aware that the usual spawns for The Mirror of Lyss will also be present along the way.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Lieutenant Murunda
:''"'''Prince Ahmtur the Mighty''' requires your services again. With the survivors evacuated, it's time to reclaim the '''temple'''. Meet me in the '''Mirror of Lyss''' for your debriefing. You will answer the princes {{sic|missing an '}} call, will you not?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I will do what you ask.
|decline = I will get back to you on that.
|ask = I will wait for you in the Mirror of Lyss. There we will discuss the plan of action for retaking the temple. }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Lieutenant Murunda
:''"I'm glad you are here, <Character name>, you have proven most worthy of our respect. I have been ordered to give you a contingent of soldiers to aid you in this misssion. These men knew what they were getting into when they volunteered for this. They know it's dangerous, and they are willing to lay down their lives if need be. Now go! Route out the evil that now dwells in this place!"''

;Defeating 1st group
:'''Vabbi Guard:''' ''"Foul beasts! Back to the Torment with you!"''

;Defeating 2nd group
:'''Vabbi Guard:''' ''"Your demise is at hand! Don't take it personally."''

;Defeating 3rd group
:'''Vabbi Guard Captain:''' ''"My blade hungers for your flesh. You wouldn't want it to go hungry, would you?"''

;Defeating 4th group
:'''Vabbi Guard:''' ''"So you think this is a game. Well, guess what? I'm winning."''

;Defeating 5th group
:'''Vabbi Guard:''' ''"Oh, that's got to hurt."''

;Defeating 6th group
:'''Vabbi Guard:''' ''"What? Did you think we were here for tea and cake?"''

;Defeating 7th group
:'''Vabbi Guard:''' ''"Have at you!"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Lieutenant Murunda
:''"You've done well, <Character name>. The prince asked me to give you this reward. It seems you have earned his trust, and mine. Those men who perished while aiding you will be honored as heroes, but I do not look forward to the unhappy task of notifying their families."''

==Notes==
*If the Margonite groups are killed out of order, the Vabbi Guard's dialogue appear in a different order as well.  Each quote is tied to a specific group.
*The Guards will follow you until the quest is finished, which makes Vanquishing this area much easier. While the quest does add the Margonite groups, it also removes most of the Kournan spawns, for only a small overall increase in foes to be vanquished.
